what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Italy in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 575 Italian asylum seekers, and the United States hosted 49.7% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are Canada, Australia and Brazil.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Italy, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 and 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 33 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 1857, at the end of 2024, and was much lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
